'''Darth Krayt's tomb''' was the intended final resting place of the founder of the [[One Sith]] order, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Krayt|Krayt]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Housed in the depths of [[XoXaan's Temple]] on the Sith grave [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the tomb was actually a [[Stasis chamber/Legends|stasis chamber]] facility prepared by Krayt's [[Regent/Legends|regent]], the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]] (who had [[Battle on Had Abbadon|murdered]] Krayt on [[Had Abbadon]]), to display Krayt's body and give the appearance that the Dark Lord simply was undergoing one of his many periods of regenerative [[Suspended animation/Legends|stasis]]. To further the illusion, Wyyrlok assigned [[Darth Talon]], who remained unaware of Krayt's death, to guard the tomb. However, when [[Darth Nihl]] convinced Talon to allow him entry, they discovered that Krayt's body was gone, leaving only his armor.

Darth Krayt had revived himself from death with his mastery of the [[Dark transfer]] technique, and returned to rule the One Sith and bring the galaxy to heel. However, at the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Coruscant]] he was slain a second time, this time by his intended apprentice [[Cade Skywalker]], who sent his body into [[Coruscant Prime/Legends|Coruscant's Sun]] where it was finally destroyed, never returning to its tomb.
